+    def _print_sinc(self, expr):
+        from sympy import Piecewise, Ne, sin
+        arg = expr.args[0]
+        # sinc(x) = sin(x)/x for x != 0, and 1 for x == 0
+        return self._print(Piecewise(
+            (sin(arg)/arg, Ne(arg, 0)),
+            (1, True)
+        ))
